title: The Legend of Zelda Is the Only Big Name Willing to Go Up Against GTA 6 in November
description: While most publishers are avoiding GTA 6 in November 2026, Nintendo is stepping into the ring. Push Square reports that The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake launches November 5 on Switch 2.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Clash of the Titans: Zelda Takes on GTA 6

For the best part of 2026, the gaming industry has been dominated by a single narrative: no major publishers are willing to release their games anywhere near *GTA 6*. As Rockstar's juggernaut looms large on the horizon, studios across the board have scrambled to adjust their release schedules, desperately avoiding the colossal shadow of the upcoming open-world epic.

However, Nintendo is famously not cut from the same cloth. According to a recent report by gaming outlet Push Square, the Japanese giant is willingly walking into the lion's den.

## The November 5 Showdown on Switch 2

As many have likely already seen in the news, *The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time* remake for the Switch 2 now has a firmly confirmed launch date. The highly anticipated title is set to arrive worldwide on **November 5**, landing a mere two weeks before Rockstar's juggernaut takes over the gaming landscape.

Positioning a first-party heavyweight like *Zelda* just a fortnight ahead of *GTA 6* is a bold and rare strategy in modern gaming. While typical industry wisdom dictates giving Rockstar's release window a wide berth, Nintendo is clearly betting on the unique ecosystem of the Switch 2 and the timeless appeal of the franchise to carve out its own massive space in the November shopping season.

## Industry Context and Impact

The clash sets up an unforgettable November for gamers, pitting one of the industry's most beloved classic remakes directly against the most anticipated entertainment launch of the decade. Whether this strategy will pay off in the face of *GTA 6*'s unprecedented market dominance remains one of the most fascinating storylines of 2026.

## Editor's Take

It takes a brave publisher to schedule a major release just two weeks before *GTA 6*. By bringing *The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time* remake to the Switch 2 on November 5, Nintendo is proving it plays by its own rules. This unexpected showdown will be a defining battle of the 2026 holiday season.
